text:
maria: Quick check — vendor put us on the waitlist for ephemeral H100 in ap-southeast1. Demo scheduled Wed, any ETA or alternate plan?
ashok: I pinged them yesterday. They said ~72h but could be faster if we confirm PO/tenant. Portal: https://vendor.example.com/waitlist/RED-123
liam: If that slips, we can move demo to eu-west1 (latency okay for demo) or do a spot-blend fallback: 2x preemptible H100 + 1 reserved A100 as a safety net.
maria: EU is OK but primary audience is APAC; prefer ap-southeast if vendor can speed up. What's the fastest fallback?
liam: Fastest = spot H100 blend. Cheap/slow = quantized CPU path (not ideal for demo). Quick command to check cloud quota/instances:
```
gcloud compute instances list --filter="zone:(asia-southeast1)" --limit=5
```
ashok: Vendor wants PO# and tenant ID to prioritize. Created ticket VEND-241 and looped in accounting. If accounting can't move, we can request a borrow from on-call. @sre-oncall can you confirm borrow band and limits?
sre-oncall: Can approve up to an 8-hour borrow for demos (max twice/week) without reserved pool changes. For sustained needs we need a reserved commit. Also flag: KMS/HSM controls if we go private.
maria: Great — plan: try vendor expedite (PO + tenant), fallback -> spot blend and notify QA. I'll update calendar and add canary route.
liam: I'll prepare the terraform patch for spot-blend and tag @ashok for review.
ashok: ACK, will review PR today. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: [quota-alert] ap-southeast1 H100 quota = 0 available, requested 4 in last 24h.
maria: Noted — copying vendor ticket: https://vendor.example.com/tickets/VEND-241
maria: Keeping thread open for updates and will post final demo decision by EOD tomorrow.
